propositions: The KNOWN_CAPABILITIES frozenset in compat.py is empty and does not register the multi-project-bridge capability, preventing older binaries from recognizing and safely rejecting stores that sync multiple tracker projects.

An unregistered binary reading a multi-project store sees unmatched bound tickets as having no remote issue and creates duplicate issues in the wrong project instead of raising StoreIncompatibleError.
Registering multi-project-bridge in KNOWN_CAPABILITIES must precede any code that writes the requirement to .store-compat.json as part of an expand/contract rollout pattern.
The write lock must refuse operations when the store declares an unknown required capability, while read operations like list/show/search and fsck continue to function.
